scope: Non-author narrow review of the two observer files within the previously reviewed five-file diff, plus offline attribution checks against saved Kyber2 attempt01/attempt02. This completes round2, not an additional or unbounded review round.
author_role: independent non-author; no source or production modifications
previous_five_file_conclusions: Retained. The original eight new fixed sample TX/N/instance mappings, real-Family ABI choice, historical-ready cost/capability/CLI scope, and no production address seeding were reviewed in review.json. The other three owned files remain byte-identical. No expanded re-audit of older system changes.

source_review.diff_scope: Only ERC20 transfer ABI addition, successful swap-subtree output attribution, swap-only receipt payer predicate, and corresponding offline tests.

locations.claim: Add transfer ABI for observation only.

Exactly one successful CALL in the selected swap subtree from pool to output token, decoded recipient and exact amount. Missing/empty returndata accepted; nonempty data must be canonical 32-byte true.
Independent receipt must retain exact recipient/amount and, only for swap branches, target-pool payer; uniqueness remains exactly one.
Sibling/duplicate/absent/outside-subtree/wrong field/revert/malformed/false and empty-return cases applied to nine Kyber and six Algebra samples, both directions.

preservation_proof.method: Remove exactly the three observer insertions from candidate evidence.ts; assert resulting text is byte-identical to before-observer-evidence.ts.
preservation_proof.caveat: This is preservation of the previously reviewed source, not a new full-system validation.

source_review.attribution_limit: Trace has no per-frame receipt logs. Attribution uses selected successful swap subtree plus unique payer/token/recipient/value CALL and independent unique receipt; no invented logIndex-to-frame mapping. Descendants rather than only direct children are accepted, with caller/payer and ancestor-success gates.

tooling_defect.summary: The transaction-wide tokenOut/to/value filter counts a successful same-token/same-amount sibling transfer from another payer as the selected Kyber pool output and falsely rejects an otherwise uniquely attributable output.
tooling_defect.reason: This predicate was preserved from baseline; the newly exercised real Kyber2 sample exposed it.
tooling_defect.codify_commit_requirement: Main/author must record the real code commit with the retained original failure and regression results before formal tooling-defect closure. Reviewer makes no commit and does not fabricate a codify_commit.

original_primary_evidence.adjudication: Confirmed tooling false ambiguity, not protocol failure. Old receipt predicate combined two distinct payers. New observer accepts the uniquely attributable selected pool payment while retaining exact CALL/event/receipt proofs.

saved_fail_before.provenance: Main's preserved run inspected independently; reviewer did not re-run old observer.
saved_fail_before.finding: All fifteen swap-sample tests fail at old output receipt uniqueness (2 !== 1); new same-value foreign payer fixture exposes the old predicate.
